errors.evidence: This sequence describing the light blue line's fluctuations is incorrect. The values are mapped to the wrong ages. For example, at age 22, the value is approximately 35% (not 41%); at age 24, it is approximately 42% (not 32%); and at age 28, it is approximately 60% (not 33%).
